description: Speed Limits for state and local roads– Point in time – Not updated is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. Speed limit information for most of Queensland’s roads at time of collection in 2019 or 2020. Includes state and locally controlled roads. Point-in-time data as per date of collection in dataset. Speed zones or links not available. No further updates planned. Coverage: Transport and Main Roads. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are Speed, TMR, signs, speed limits. It offers 64 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-07-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
